CJP seeks action against hate speech, questions Union Minister Dharmendra Pradhan

The Centre for Justice and Peace (CJP) has submitted a memorandum to the government, demanding action against hate speech and questioning Union Minister Dharmendra Pradhan's role. While CJP's primary demand is for action on hate speech, some discussions also involve calls for Pradhan's resignation or removal, with one outlet suggesting direct demands be made to the Prime Minister.
